description: This source file defines the 'Order' aggregate root entity class for the eShopOnWeb application. It includes properties for buyer information, shipping address, order items, and total calculation, following Domain-Driven Design patterns.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order as an aggregate root, encapsulating order details, items, and behavior like total price calculation.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new Order with buyer ID, shipping address, and order items.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price of the order based on its order items.
